text.card: A red giant 1,823 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.55 solar masses and 16.5 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,592 K at its surface.
